findings.description: Direct dispatch input interpolation into Bash could execute runner commands.
findings.exploitPrecondition: Malicious actor can trigger or influence workflow input.
findings.remediation: Move to environment variables, validate before use, use arrays.
findings.residualRisk: Validator covers current workflows; future edits need review

findings.description: Push to main previously could publish with OIDC.
findings.remediation: Explicit dispatch publish job with scoped OIDC and environment.

findings.description: Remote registry could select file or private network destinations.
findings.remediation: HTTPS default, file opt-in, same origin, private address and redirect checks.
findings.residualRisk: DNS rebinding needs network egress enforcement

findings.description: HTTP could allocate unbounded body before size check.
findings.remediation: Streaming ceiling, file stat and decompression ceiling.
findings.residualRisk: Default 512 MiB bound is large; consumers should lower

findings.description: Manifest self-hash was not checked; shard size not checked before parse.
findings.remediation: Recompute self-hash, optional pin, byteSize before parse.
findings.residualRisk: Checksum integrity is not publisher authentication; use a trusted pin or channel

findings.description: Checksum-valid shard could contradict administrative semantics.
findings.exploitPrecondition: Malicious or corrupt shard with matching checksum.
findings.remediation: Validate parent, boundary kind, confidence and source relationships.
findings.residualRisk: Source policy still depends on trusted manifest

findings.description: Multiple source changes collapsed to one kind.
findings.exploitPrecondition: Source checksum and metadata change together.
findings.residualRisk: Exact geometry impacts require candidate rebuild

findings.description: Production dependency advisories were removed; a high advisory remains in documentation build tooling.
findings.remediation: Resolve React Native workspace peers to 0.87.1 and patch same-major transitive dependencies; retain release gate until VitePress supports a patched Vite line.
findings.residualRisk: 0 production high, 1 total high (Vite 5.4.21 through stable VitePress 1.6.4)

findings.description: Main has no verified protection or ruleset.
findings.exploitPrecondition: Maintainer or compromised credential pushes directly.
findings.remediation: Enable required PR, checks, reviews and force-push protection.
findings.testEvidence: gh api rulesets and branch protection
findings.residualRisk: Source control cannot enforce remote settings
